comparison.interpretation: Both candidates passed all 43 frozen external checks. This one task does not establish general superiority. Department produced a complete plan/test/check/mutation/Verifier workflow, but required substantially more time, tokens and operator interventions. Its Verifier's own test command failed in its environment, so the independent-review evidence is weaker than the pass label alone suggests.

limitations: One benchmark task and one candidate per arm cannot establish average reliability or general superiority.
The 43-check grader is not exhaustive; the post-hoc Single probe is excluded from the frozen score.
Usage costs are not reported as actual billed amounts; both arms use subscription CLI access.
Department is awaiting acceptance in the app; acceptance/delivery was not part of this score run.
GitHub CI was not run as part of this local benchmark.
